purpose: Retrospectively preserve and connect the generated CoCivium human-facing hero artwork as a future-reusable media seed, with provenance and accessibility.

media_seeds.title: A Living Continuity System

public_preview.format: SVG with embedded JPEG preview pixels

media_seeds.prompt_origin: Original AI-generated CoCivium/CoAll UX concept in user-directed CoDry+/CoWet+ rich media exploration, 2026-11-09
media_seeds.semantic_summary: Braided glowing orbital continuity hero with Futures, Retros, CoMap, media lineage and Quiet mode; an illustration of a possible UI, not a working app.
media_seeds.rights: AI-generated concept, subject to human review for external release

coev_policy_candidate.hero_visual: For new public human-facing surfaces, offer one substantial contextual hero or equivalent purposeful rich media. Backfill important historical surfaces where it improves comprehension; do not inject decoration into utilitarian/security interfaces.
coev_policy_candidate.media_lineage: Every generated image/audio/video candidate receives exact digest, work identity, role, source reference, semantic caption, privacy decision, relationships, proposed uses and testable acceptance.
coev_policy_candidate.audio: DEFAULT_SILENT. Scrolling MUST NOT cause sound to activate; volume can evolve from zero only after clear opt-in. Respect persistent quiet choice, reduced motion, accessible controls and captions.
coev_policy_candidate.inverse: CoDry should be deliberate, not accidental. CoWet must improve usability, not mask missing evidence.

next_proof: Integrate preview into one authorized human-facing page and verify its rendered accessibility and opt-in audio behavior.
